title: Preservation of space under symbol lifting
statement: Let $\Gamma$ have decidable equality, let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols, and let $e:\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\hookrightarrow\Gamma$ be an embedding. For every Boolean input word $x$, configuration $c$ of $M$ on $x$, and $t\in\mathbb{N}$, the total number of work-tape cells visited through step $t$ by the lifted computation from the lifted configuration equals that for the original computation from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of Boolean symbols into $\Gamma$
